statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Archpriest
statBlock.description: A priest of the kuo-toa wields lightning through a scepter and calls on its faith to protect allies.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The kuo-toa breathes both air and water.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Strange Scepter attacks.
Strange Scepter. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 20 (5d6 + 3) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 14) without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Destructive Wave, Divination, Hold Monster (level 6 version), Scrying, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Shield of Faith (2/day). Cast Shield of Faith using Wisdom, as in Spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Monitor
statBlock.description: A kuo-toa enforcer keeps enemies at a distance with a whip of bone and lightning.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The kuo-toa breathes both air and water.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bone Whip attacks.
Bone Whip. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage. The target cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of the kuo-toa's next turn.

statBlock.name: Kuo-toa Whip
statBlock.description: A kuo-toa devotee pins foes with a pincer staff, hurls caustic slime, and casts Shield of Faith.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The kuo-toa breathes both air and water.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Pincer Staff. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is Grappled, escape DC 12. The kuo-toa cannot make Pincer Staff attacks while this grapple lasts.
Conjure Slimy Glob. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 9 (3d4 + 2) acid damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shield of Faith (2/day). Cast Shield of Faith using Wisdom.

statBlock.name: Quaggoth
statBlock.description: A long-clawed Underdark predator climbs as fast as it walks and fights hardest when wounded.

sections.Traits: Bloodied Fury. While Bloodied, the quaggoth has Advantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. While the quaggoth is Bloodied, a hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage instead.

statBlock.name: Quaggoth Thonot
statBlock.description: A quaggoth with psionic gifts can fend off harm and strike at the mind as well as the body.

sections.Traits: Bloodied Fury. While Bloodied, the quaggoth has Advantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell with Wisdom (save DC 12), requiring no spell components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible), Minor Illusion.
2/day. Mind Spike.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense (3/day total). When Feather Fall or Shield is triggered, cast the triggering spell without components using Wisdom, as in Spellcasting. Both spells draw from the same three uses.

statBlock.name: Sahuagin Baron
statBlock.description: This four-armed sea fiend leads sahuagin raids and turns its own spilled blood into a curse.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature below its hit point maximum.
Limited Amphibiousness. The sahuagin breathes air and water and must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
Shark Telepathy. The sahuagin can use special telepathy to magically control sharks within 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Trident attacks.
Trident. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Fiendish Blood. When the sahuagin takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature it chooses in a 5-ft. Emanation from it makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is cursed until it finishes a Short or Long Rest. While cursed, the creature cannot benefit from being Invisible, its Speed decreases by 10 ft., and every Fiend within 120 ft. of the creature can sense its location even through obstacles.

statBlock.name: Merrow
statBlock.description: An ogre-like aquatic hunter uses a harpoon to pull prey toward its jaws. Merrow ambush travelers in coastal waters and raid nearby settlements.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merrow breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bite, Claw, and Harpoon.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of the merrow's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
Harpoon. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The merrow pulls a Large or smaller creature hit by the harpoon up to 15 ft. straight toward itself.
